text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH latency spike in EU inference cluster. Route: /v1/generate (model=stable-13b). Observed p95=1100ms (baseline ~350ms), error rate +1.2%. Incident ID INC-2026-0423. Paging @sara @rafa @eng-sre.

sara: Ack — I'm on it. Jumping into traces and recent host metrics. Any recent deploys? :eyes:

deploy-bot: No active deploys to eu-serving in the last 2h. No new model rollouts.

rafa: grabbing flamegraphs + live tail of nginx/gunicorn. Starting `hbctl evict` on a suspected overloaded node to test impact.

mike: adding metrics snapshot from Grafana (snip):
```
p95_latency_eu: 1100ms
p50_latency_eu: 210ms
cpu_util_nodes_eu: 92% (some pods >98%)
inflight_requests_route_v1_generate: +40%
```

anita: Support queue seeing increased customer complaints for EU region — mainly slow responses, some timeouts. Top ticket: #SUP-8423.

tom: Product — please triage customer impact: are SLAs impacted or just degraded latency?

sara: SLA not yet breached (errors low), but user experience degraded. Recommend status page entry: "Degraded Performance - EU inference" and a customer advisory that we're investigating. Draft below.

status-bot: Proposed status update posted to staging: 
```
Component: EU Inference (service)
Status: Investigating — Degraded Performance
Impact: Increased latency for text generation APIs in EU region. Some customers may experience slower responses or timeouts.
Update: Engineering is investigating. No customer data exposure reported.
```

mike: Thx. Suggest mitigation steps: 1) scale up pool by +2 GPU nodes (r4), 2) toggle auto-batch to lower batch size for low-latency paths, 3) route critical customers to dedicated pool as a short-term workaround.

rafa: Started scale up. K8s: applied `kubectl scale --replicas=+2 deployment/eu-runtime-pool` and draining 1 suspect node for diagnostics. Also rolling back a local config change to `kv_cache=True` that was toggled earlier — testing impact now.

sara: Good. Also enabling prefix caching for high-volume routes. Monitoring for 10m.

anita: Draft customer note (for support to send):
```
Hi <Customer>,
We are investigating increased latency impacting EU inference endpoints. Our engineers are actively mitigating; you may see slower responses for generation requests. We expect improvements within 30-45 minutes. We'll follow up with a confirmation once performance is back to normal.
Regards,
Redwood Support
```

mike: Make sure to include a link to status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0423 and an estimated ETA.

rafa: Update: after scaling + draining, p95 dropped to ~480ms at 12:06 UTC. Error rate steady. Continuing to monitor.

sara: Nice. Leaving a few action items before I handoff in 20m: 1) ensure autoscaler policies are holding, 2) validate no upstream network flaps, 3) keep status page updated. Handoff to @rafa at 12:30 UTC.

rafa: Taking over. Monitor window set to 2m cadence. If p95 stays <500ms for 15m, start to de-escalate. Plan: maintain scaled capacity for 30m then gradually remove extra nodes.

status-bot: Status page updated: Investigating -> Identified mitigations in progress — Degraded Performance.

anita: Sending customer advisory now to affected accounts with ETA 30m. Template contains link to status and contact info.

mike: Reminder: open a postmortem issue and include trace IDs + host IDs for the nodes we drained.

rafa: Quick diagnostic finding — one node showed repeated kernel-level preemption and OOM-killer activity for the runtime process. Suspect noisy neighbor on the host. We're marking that host as unhealthy in fleet.

sara: Good catch. Add to postmortem: host-level contention, autoscaler thresholds too low for sudden bursts.

status-bot: Final update: Resolved — Performance restored. p95 back to ~320ms, error rate normalized. Incident INC-2026-0423 closed and moved to follow-up.

anita: Notifying customers that service is restored and linking postmortem when available.

tom: Thanks team. Please file the postmortem with timeline and remediation (autoscaler tuning, better health checks, potential host isolation improvements).

rafa: Filed postmortem draft at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0423-PM. Leaving logs and drain artifacts there.

sara: Stand down — I'm available if anything regresses. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
